seoContent.title: Science trivia questions for
seoContent.description: Generate science trivia questions, review clear answers, and explore weekly science themes built from surprising facts.
seoContent.intro: Science Trivia is built around short question sets and weekly themes. Generate five fresh questions when you want a quick challenge, then browse the archive for deeper explanations that connect related science facts.

sections.title: Five science questions on demand
sections.content: Each generated set gives you five science trivia questions with answers and explanations. The goal is a compact quiz that feels surprising, clear, and worth finishing.

sections.title: Weekly science themes
sections.content: The archive turns selected questions into broader themes, connecting everyday chemistry, the human body, nature, space, materials, and physics into readable explanations.

sections.title: Trivia questions with answers and explanations
sections.content: Every set is designed to be more useful than a bare quiz prompt, with clear answers and explanations that make each question feel satisfying after you play.

sections.title: An archive built for science reading
sections.content: The archive is not just a list of old questions. It is a growing collection of weekly science topics that use trivia as an entry point into deeper ideas.

sections.title: Built to spark curiosity, not just test memory
sections.content: The tone of Science Trivia is intentionally human and curiosity-driven. The best questions reveal a mechanism, a misconception, or a pattern you can remember after the quiz ends.

sections.title: A quick science quiz for repeat play
sections.content: The quiz uses cached question groups so repeat sessions can keep feeling fresh. When one group is finished, the next generated set pulls a new group of five science questions.

seoContent.conclusion: Generate a set of five science trivia questions, review the answers, and browse the archive whenever you want a deeper theme.
